topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Finding out that my child has the same teacher I once had... it's like being caught in a time loop, a relentless echo of the past. I walk the same halls, past the same posters that haven't changed, and now my child will too. The weight of it all, the unyielding march of years that somehow bring you back to the same spot. I can feel the walls closing in, the old whispers of doubt and expectation. How do I explain this to my child, the gravity of this coincidence, without burdening them with my shadows? It's a tightrope, and I'm not sure I can keep my balance.
